mechanism: Introduce one original character through habitat, wake behavior and locomotion before assigning a skilled task. Let the first technical attempt create a visible recoverable failure, then make the character use one identity-defining body feature as a practical reasoning or control instrument. The success state must visibly answer the failure and end in a clean competence pose with the changed object.

invariants.rule: Establish habitat, intimate reaction and locomotion before the technical task.
invariants.purpose: Builds personality and physical rules before judging skill.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting at the workbench reduces the character to a decorative technician.

invariants.rule: Show one skilled task with a readable intermediate state.
invariants.purpose: Makes later failure specific and inspectable.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained accident cannot prove what changed.

invariants.rule: Keep the failure recoverable and preserve the same task object.
invariants.purpose: Supports causal repair instead of reset magic.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the object erases the consequence.

invariants.rule: Use one identity-defining body feature as a practical tool in the solution.
invariants.ablation_failure: If any generic tool solves the problem, the body design is only ornament.

invariants.rule: End with the repaired or transformed object and a restrained competence pose together.
invariants.purpose: Provides visible proof of learning and success.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reaction without the result cannot close the task.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is readable without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: carrier_or_token
slots.constraint: One visible material, prop or symbolic anchor that carries the causal mechanism.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: A sequence of visible, causally ordered changes rather than decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each change without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final state that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of visible-action sounds; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: Ayotl name and source folklore attribution
source turtle-like creature, shell markings and color design
hammock wake-up, floating gears, crystal experiment and source equations
the exact source workshop, explosion, self-writing surface and hero pose
